options.name: dn
options.description: The distinguished name of the LDAP object.

options.name: filter
options.description: A LDAP search filter to select objects.

options.name: module
options.description: The udm module for which objects are to be modified

options.name: set_properties
options.description: A list of dictionaries with the keys property and value. Properties of the objects are to be set to the given values.

options.name: state
options.description: Either 'present' for creating or modifying the objects given with 'dn' and 'filter' or 'absent' for deleting the objects from the LDAP. Default is 'present'.

options.name: superordinate
options.description: When creating a new object, set its superordinate to this DN. Only affects newly created LDAP objects, this option is ignored for modifications and removals of existing entries.

options.name: unset_properties
options.description: A list of dictionaries with the key property. The listed properties of the objects are to be unset.
